description: Evidence-grounded supplier, pricing, renewal, performance, continuity, and approval-brief preparation.

routing.when_to_use: Use for evidenced supplier intake, comparison, pricing, contract/renewal, performance, continuity-risk, or approval-brief preparation.
when_not_to_use: Do not use as a purchasing, ERP, payment, or supplier connector.
Do not order, accept, negotiate, renew, terminate, send, or mutate vendor records.
Do not use with live credentials, bank details, private vendor data, or private contract text.
exclusion_rules: Consumer procurement owners retain spending and acceptance authority.
Owning integrations retain vendor credentials and system mutation authority.

required_inputs.name: request
required_inputs.description: Synthetic request, procurement workflow, source evidence, authority, and privacy classification.

expected_outputs.name: result
expected_outputs.description: Auditable preparation, denial, or escalation with no live effects.

execution.procedure_summary: Normalize supplier evidence, compare claims and risk, prepare an owner-bound artifact, and retain redacted audit state.
forbidden_actions: Store or echo credentials, bank data, private vendor data, or contract text
Create orders or mutate supplier systems
Spend, accept, negotiate, renew, terminate, or send
Infer consumer approval or supplier state
verification_steps: Confirm no prohibited paths or live effects
completion_criteria: Owner, escalation, idempotency, and rollback are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: retain synthetic IDs, evidence hashes, and receipts only
